 Print Every contestant’s journey in Bigg Boss Malayalam Season 8 offers a glimpse into their past experiences. Sometimes, these revelations emerge during tasks or conversations in the house. On other occasions, old videos shared by contestants before entering the show resurface and grab attention. Rahul Easwar, one of the contestants in Bigg Boss Malayalam Season 8, is among those whose past reality TV experience has come back into focus. He is being remembered for his journey as the winner of Malayali House and the memories associated with the show. In the video circulating online, Rahul recounts his 100-day experience on Malayali House, which aired in 2013. Reflecting on his time on the show, Rahul shared that it was his first reality TV experience and a major victory for him. He added that the contestants had to give up their mobile phones and stay away from television and the internet for 100 days. ‘At that time, we made a lot of good friends. It became a unique experience in my life and a part of Malayalam television history,’ he added. Beyond the competition, Rahul said the show gave him several lasting friendships. He fondly remembers his fellow contestants, including G. S. Pradeep, Sindhu Joy, Sneha , Rosin Jolly, Sandeep, Dalu Krishnadas and Sojan. According to Rahul, the relationships he formed during the show remain an important part of his life. He also spoke about interacting with housemates from diverse backgrounds, including those from social and intellectual fields. ‘Winning Malayali House is one of the most important events in my life that I remember,’ he added. Rahul’s early reality TV experiences are now grabbing attention online as he participates in Bigg Boss Malayalam 8. His words offer a glimpse into his journey on Malayali House and the relationships he built with his fellow contestants. For the uninitiated, Malayali House is a reality TV show hosted by veteran actress Revathy and inspired by the original Dutch show Big Brother. The show features 16 Malayalis living under one roof without any communication with the outside world. Rahul Easwar won the first season of Malayali House.
